title: Kagamine Len — My Cheer For You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds
Lalala♪ Lala♪ La♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? That voice... Is it Rin?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Her singing sounds so chipper. Did something good happen for her?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Lucky. I wonder if something good will happen for me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, a fragment of a feeling!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's such a pretty color.
What kind of feeling was this born from?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I think I'll give it a touch!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hello...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa! There's a bunch of toys!
Oh, and there's a big TV over there!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What is this place? A toy SEKAI, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, it's got CDs with me and Rin on them!
Whoa, and lots of merch too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. This place seems pretty fun, so maybe I'll take a look arou—
*Sniffle* *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Is somebody crying...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm, I think it's coming from over here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, is somebody there?
Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So it was this girl crying... Wait, why is there a person here?!)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh... Are you... Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa! Y-Yeah, I am...
You know about me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... Yu loves you, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yu? Is that a friend of yours?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, whoa, don't cry!
Um... I sure do wonder where we are...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I think this is a hospital, because it's kind of like the one he's in...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yu's in a hospital? Is he not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Mhm... They say he was born with a bad sickness...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
So, you've visited him in the hospital a lot?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Yeah... I went every day.
But... I haven't visited him since we had that fight.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A fight?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I said something awful to him...
But I don't know how to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It's been really lonely, so today I went to sleep listening to one of your songs that he told me about.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: And then I was here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (This Yu might just be the owner of these feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So she wandered into this place because she's related to what he's feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Hmm, but this isn't a SEKAI yet, so is that really...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Um, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah, yeah? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Did you see Yu?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I heard you crying right after I arrived, but... I haven't seen anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, want to go look for him together?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But... We had that fight...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, would you mind telling me about this Yu?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
He's a precious friend of yours, right?
I want to know more about him.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! So he lives in the house across from yours.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah. When I was little, I used to play at his house all the time.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: He's always been really sick, though, so his dad would be there with us.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh yeah, Yu's dad said he used you and Rin to make songs a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, wow! Hehehe, that makes me pretty happy.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Hehe. Yu also loves you two, and he's told me about lots of wonderful songs.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: So, I want to sing your songs with him someday.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, nice! But when you say “someday”... Is that because of his illness?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... Mom said it makes it hard for him to breathe.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I thought we would be able to go to elementary school together... But he was only there for the entrance ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So it's really serious...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
It is, and I...
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Why did you two fight?
Could you tell me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Well...
